messages:
amy: deploy-bot just alerted a canary p95 jump for v3.6.0 (~560ms). We have Dedicated routes in the rollout. Can we hold auto-revert and do a canary-only rollback?

deploy-bot: Alert: p95 > 500ms for 3m on canary slice. Policy suggests autorevert to 3.5.2.

ben: Hold please. Auto will touch Dedicated. Proposing manual canary rollback + pin for Dedicated.

ops-bot: @amy hold placed: suppressing auto-rollback for 12 minutes. Manual mitigation recommended.

amy: Plan: 1) rollback canary to 3.5.2; 2) pin Dedicated routes to 3.5.2; 3) notify CS; 4) open post-mortem.

ben: I'll run the rollback and pin. Commands: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --service=inference --to-version=3.5.2 --slice=canary` and `redwoodctl routes pin --route=dedicated-us --version=3.5.2`.

amy: Quick logs show kv-cache misses + quant fallback. Likely kernel selector regression.

ben: Rolling back canary now.

ops-bot: ACTION: ben started rollback at 2026-05-01T10:12:15Z. Job id: rb-4700000000-1

ben: Canary rollback complete. Running smoke.

ben: Smoke: p95 back to 130ms, 502 errors cleared in canary logs.

cs: Sending short customer note to AE/CS: "We observed increased latency for a canary subset during v3.6.0 rollout. Canary rolled back and Dedicated routes pinned to the prior stable release. No customer action required. Post-mortem to follow."

amy: Opening post-mortem ticket with traces and rollback commands. Keep canary pinned for 45m then re-evaluate.

deploy-bot: Manual rollback recorded. Recommendation: revert kernel selector change for next candidate.

amy: Thanks team. Closing for now. If regression, ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
